abLink: About the project and your data
ab1: A non-commercial project, a sister project of the Kinkosmos site. No ads, no paid features. Data is never sold or handed to anyone.
ab2:
Date of birth (others see an age group or the exact age — your choice), gender, nickname, «About», what you look for and who to show.
Checklist answers — encrypted.
A map area of about 1 km — the point itself is not kept.
Which connected chats you are in.
Your Telegram id, @username and Telegram name — so that you can be written to after a mutual like.
Your likes and «not now», reports.
On this phone: a copy of the neighbours list and mutual likes so the app opens faster (at most 7 days old). Clear it: «Profile» → «Settings» → «Data on this phone»; deleting the account wipes it.
ab3: Exact coordinates, conversations, group messages, photos.
ab4:
Neighbours from your chats (and from the Universe — checked chats approved by the owner — and from open space, if you switched them on): nickname, gender, age (a group or exact — the person's choice), role, rough distance, match percent, «About» (if open) and the checklist comparison (unless turned off).
After a mutual like: your Telegram name, exact age and a link to your profile.
Your like is seen right away — your nickname and card, without name or Telegram. Your «not now» is never shown.
The admin and moderators: profiles and answers for moderation, never your location. The admin also sees who you have a like or a mutual like with and who changed it — to sort out errors and reports. And a general people map: each person's rough zone (~5 km²) with the nickname — the bot keeps nothing finer than the zone. Every such view goes to the journal. The admin can read messages sent with a like — to handle reports and spam; every opening is logged too. The admin can open your Telegram account, moderators only if you were reported. Every such view goes to a journal.
ab5: On Cloudflare servers; the database is in the European Union.
ab6:
If you do not open Kinkoverse for 2 months, your profile is hidden from the map. After 5 months the bot starts warning about deletion (three times, once a month); after 8 months the profile is deleted.
The admin's and moderators' view journal is kept for 180 days.
ab7: «Profile» → «Settings» → «Delete account». Everything is deleted at once. If a moderator blocked the account, only the block mark stays.
ab8: A contact form will come later.
